title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BENCH:BACK REST (319,181 affected)
summary: THE POWER SEAT OR RECLINER WIRING HARNESS CAN BE PINCHED OR CAN CHAFE ON THE SEAT FRAME OR SPRING SUPPORT ROD, WEARING THROUGH THE WIRE INSULATION AND CAUSING AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:VACUUM BRAKE SYSTEM (246 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY HAS A PUSHROD PIN THAT IS TOO SMALL AND IT IS INSTALLED IN THE WRONG POSITION, CAUSING AN INCREASED BRAKE PEDAL RATIO AND A DECREASED MASTER CYLINDER STROKE.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (6,838 affected)
summary: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLES INSTALLED AS PART OF HARLEY- DAVIDSON'S PREVIOUS RECALL 077 (NHTSA RECALL 92V011000) CAN FAIL IN SERVICE.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (1,526 affected)
summary: INCORRECT SCREWS WERE USED TO ATTACH THE PLYWOOD SEAT BACK TO THE SEAT FRAME.

title: General Motors, LLC: WHEELS (6,784 affected)
summary: THE 19.5 X 6 FRONT STEEL WHEEL DISC CRACKS OUTSIDE THE MOUNTING BOLT CIRCLE AND ENDS AT THE HUB'S DIAMETER.

title: Adient, PLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY (19,441 affected)
summary: THE SEAL ON THE VENT CAPS OF THESE BATTERIES CAN BE BROKEN DUE TO A CRACK AT OR ABOVE THE SCREW IN THREAD. THE CRACK IS CAUSED BY USE OF AN INCORRECT MATERIAL IN THE PRODUCTION OF THE VENT CAPS.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (591 affected)
summary: THE JAM-NUTS FOR THE RIGHT AND LEFT HAND TIE RODS IN THE DRAG LINK WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED AFTER INSTALLATION.

title: AUTOMATIC EQUIP. MFG. CO.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (2,312 affected)
summary: TOW BAR CAN DEVELOP CRACKS IN THE CENTER PLATE MOUNTING WHERE THE TWO LEGS ARE ATTACHED. THE CRACKING IS CAUSED BY METAL FATIGUE IN A POTENTIALLY WEAK PART OF THE TOW BAR.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (3,000 affected)
summary: THE FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER CONTROL ARM TENSION STRUT WASHERS CAN CRACK AND FALL OFF DUE TO HYDROGEN EMBRITTLEMENT.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (12,650 affected)
summary: THE VENTURI TUBE LOCATED IN THE THROTTLE VALVE HOUSING CAN BECOME LOOSE AND FALL AGAINST THE THROTTLE PLATE.

title: FISHER-PRICE, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (14,000 affected)
summary: THE RED BUTTON ON THE BUCKLE OF THE CHILD SAFETY SEAT CAN DISLODGE FROM THE CASING CAUSING ONE OF THE APPENDAGES ATTACHED TO THE BUTTON TO BE OUTSIDE ITS PROTECTIVE CASING.

title: Utility Trailer Manufacturing Company: STRUCTURE:BOGIE OR SLIDING TANDEM (320 affected)
summary: AN INADEQUATE WELD SIZE AT THE INTERSECTION OF A 3/8 INCH VERTICAL ANGLE AND A 1/4 INCH DIAGONAL ANGLE NEAR THE BOTTOM ON THE PINTLE HOOK PLATE ASSEMBLY COULD FAIL.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (7,526 affected)
summary: A NUT WHICH JOINS THE WHEEL SPINDLE AND A BALL JOINT IN THE FRONT SUSPENSION WAS NOT PROPERLY TORQUED.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (500 affected)
summary: THE SERVICE BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER WAS NOT PROPERLY ASSEMBLED OR COULD HAVE BEEN DAMAGED BY THE EVACUATION AND FILLING OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM AT THE ASSEMBLY PLANT.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (3,500 affected)
summary: THE SERVICE BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER WAS NOT PROPERLY ASSEMBLED OR COULD HAVE BEEN DAMAGED BY THE EVACUATION AND FILLING OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM AT THE ASSEMBLY PLANT.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (1,500 affected)
summary: ONE OR BOTH OF THE BOLTS SECURING THE AUTOMATIC SEAT BELT RESTRAINT SYSTEM TRACKS TO THE B-PILLARS WERE NOT ADEQUATELY TIGHTENED.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (3,500 affected)
summary: ONE OR BOTH OF THE BOLTS SECURING THE AUTOMATIC SEAT BELT RESTRAINT SYSTEM TRACKS TO THE B-PILLARS WERE NOT ADEQUATELY TIGHTENED.

title: MALLARD COACH CORP.: STRUCTURE (31 affected)
summary: THE MOTORHOMES HAVE POOR HANDLING CHARACTERISTICS AND ARE SUBJECT TO INSTABILITY DUE TO IMPROPER WEIGHT DISTRIBUTION. ALSO, THE CHASSIS WAS NOT CERTIFIED BY A CHASSIS MANUFACTURER.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (554,910 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (ECU) FOR THE POWER DOOR LOCK SYSTEM CAN FAIL, CAUSING THE CONTACTS TO "WELD", AND RESULTING IN DOOR LOCK SOLENOID DAMAGE, WITH FAILURE OF THE DOOR TO LOCK OR UNLOCK, EVEN UNDER MANUAL OPERATION.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER/WASHER SWITCH (2,942 affected)
summary: THE SCREW THAT SECURES THE WIPER SWITCH AT ONE LOCATION AND WHICH ALSO PROVIDES A GROUND FOR THE WIPER CIRCUIT, LOOSENS AS THE SWITCH IS OPERATED OVER A LONG PERIOD OF TIME. AS THE SCREW CONTINUES TO LOOSEN THE GROUND FOR THE WIPER CIRCUIT IS INTERMITTENTLY OR COMPLETELY LOST.

title: VALEO THERMIQUE HABITACLE: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER (30,000 affected)
summary: THE END CAP CONNECTING THE HEAT EXCHANGER'S CORE TO THE ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM COULD RUPTURE AND ALLOW THE HOT COOLANT TO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.

title: Mazda North American Operations: WHEELS (15,822 affected)
summary: THE STEEL SPOKED WHEEL ASSEMBLIES INSTALLED AS STANDARD EQUIPMENT OR OFFERED AS AN OPTION ON THESE VEHICLES WERE IMPROPERLY WELDED DURING ASSEMBLY OF THE WHEEL RIM TO DISK, WHICH CAN CAUSE CRACKS IN THE WHEEL.
